scope: Same fixed grid in training and evaluation; only episode noise seeds are held out. No unseen-map, physics, ROS or hardware claim.

environment.slip_semantics: Command executes with 1-p; left/right perpendicular action each with p/2.
environment.reward_semantics: Goal +20 replaces step cost; other free moves -1; blocked moves -5 and remain in place.

training.primary_selection: Declared before evaluation; not best-seed selection.
training.epsilon_decay: linear to floor during first 80% of episodes

evaluation_design.common_random_numbers: Every policy/condition receives the same per-episode uniform noise stream; random policy uses a separate decision stream.
evaluation_design.bfs_semantics: Replans from actual cell after every move; shortest on deterministic grid, ignores slip and reward.
evaluation_design.reported_return: Undiscounted reward sum; training uses gamma-discounted targets.
evaluation_design.intervals: 95% Wilson intervals describe 100 episode successes for a fixed policy, not training uncertainty.
